children: Sandisk Corp. (SNDK, Financials) was up nearly 12% , adding $184 to its share price in a single session. It was a terrific day for the memory stocks. Micron, Seagate and Western Digital were each approximately 6% higher.
Sandisk just ran a lot farther. The thrill comes from an old friend: AI. Running and training AI models produces a lot of data, and all that data needs to live somewhere.
That is bringing storage companies into an AI revolution that has been all about processors and servers. This is an exciting prospect especially for Sandisk whose company relies on NAND flash memory.
But NAND has a history investors know well. Then too much supply pushes prices down. Demand pushes prices higher and producers add capacity.
The advent of AI does not eliminate that risk. Friday's rally suggests that investors are betting that this cycle will last longer than usual.
Management's comments on AI demand, NAND price and the duration of the current storage boom will get another airing at the next Sandisk investor conferences.

title: Sandisk Jumps 12% as AI Storage Trade Keeps Running
